# ankra_ai_review_related_repository (Resource)

Relates two repositories so an AI code review of either may read the other. The counterpart of `ankra org ai-review related-repos add` and `remove`. The platform checks that the GitHub App installation reaches both repositories. A pair is unordered: relating B to A is the same pair as A to B. Changes need organisation admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_review_related_repository" "portal_api" {
  binding_external_id    = "48151623"
  repo_full_name         = "acme/portal"
  related_repo_full_name = "acme/api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `binding_external_id` (String) GitHub App installation id the relationship belongs to.
- `related_repo_full_name` (String) The other repository, `owner/name`.
- `repo_full_name` (String) One repository, `owner/name`.

### Optional

- `scm_provider` (String) Source-control provider. Defaults to `github`, the only provider related repositories support today.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Relationship id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Related repositories are imported by "<scm_provider>/<binding_external_id>/<id>".
terraform import ankra_ai_review_related_repository.portal_api github/48151623/2c4e6a80-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
